faq_heading: Homes near Westerman Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Westerman Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Westerman Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Westerman Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Westerman Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Strawberry Hill Elementary (0.4 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (0.7 km west) and Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Westerman Elementary

33 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Westerman Elementary in a straight line (22 elementary, 8 secondary, 3 other; 6 independent). The closest is Strawberry Hill Elementary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Surrey Muslim School, 2.5 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Princess Margaret Secondary (1.6 km); the nearest independent school is Khalsa School Newton (1.4 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Chalmers Elementary (1.8 km). Other elementary schools close by: Strawberry Hill Elementary (0.4 km east), Jarvis Traditional Elementary (0.7 km west), Cougar Creek Elementary (1.2 km south), Dr F D Sinclair Elementary (1.3 km east), Kennedy Trail Elementary (1.4 km north). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Strawberry Hill Elementary, 0.4 km east of Westerman Elementary.
